Aisha Patel: quick note from a bench run — speculative decode on ozma-13b-quant-int8 (onboard candidate) against eval-v3 (2.5k prompts: docs + dialogue). saw p95 drop ~28%, p50 ~21%, throughput ~2.1x. downside: token-regens up 0.6% -> 3.4%, ROUGE-L -0.9, BLEU -0.4. some small hallucination cases surfaced. thinking about a tiny canary. opinions?

Liam Chen: can you paste the exact harness args and split? which speculative window / factor? also which quant build (per-channel/per-tensor)?

Aisha Patel: ran with spec_factor=1.15, spec_window=3, prefix_cache=false, batch=6. quant build: int8-perchannel fastkernels. split used: docs_dialogue_mixed. Command:
```
rci eval run --model ozma-13b-quant-int8 --speculative 1.15 --spec-window 3 --cache-prefix false --batch 6 --suite eval-v3 --split docs_dialogue_mixed
```
Artifacts and full run-config at /artifacts/1739998888/config.json

spec-bot: run-summary: model=ozma-13b-quant-int8 | spec=1.15 | tokens=3.1M | p50=95ms (baseline 120ms) | p95=260ms (baseline 360ms) | throughput=2.1x | regen_rate=3.4% (baseline 0.6%) | rouge_l=-0.9 pts | bleu=-0.4 pts | ppl +0.05 | seed=20240402 | artifacts=/artifacts/1739998888

Ravi Kapoor: 28% p95 is fantastic for infra budgets, but regen jump needs root-cause. any patterns in where regen happens (long answers, code blocks, lists)?

Aisha Patel: quick skim: regens concentrated in: (a) long procedural docs where the model emits an extra step, (b) multi-turn clarifications in dialogue prompts, (c) code_snippet outputs occasionally reorder import lines. I pulled 40 diffs into the samples tar for triage.

Maya Thompson: ops note: speculative reduces average GPU time but increases kernel churn — can add jitter on smaller boxes. recommend canary on isolated pool. propose canary plan: 0.2% traffic for 48h, instrument: regen_rate, rouge_l, user-regens, safety hooks, p95 latency. kill if regen_rate > 1.8% OR rouge_l delta < -1.0 OR safety flags > baseline + 0.25%. Capture raw side-by-side diffs to s3 for manual review. :white_check_mark:

Liam Chen: +1 on ablation matrix. we should sweep spec_factor in {1.05, 1.1, 1.15, 1.2} x quant_variant in {int8-perchannel, int8-per-tensor, int4-experimental} x cache {on, off}. plot regen vs p95 tradeoff. also run safety detectors (toxicity, hallucination heuristics) and adversarial prompts.

ops-bot: FYI — scheduling constraint applied: will only schedule canary workloads on nodes tagged "canary-isolated". reserving 4 GPUs.

Ravi Kapoor: can we get a small human eval on samples? I'll run a 100-case blind check for correctness vs baseline focusing on procedural correctness and hallucination.

Aisha Patel: plan: 1) kick off ablation grid tonight (48h), 2) collect metrics + sample diffs, 3) review human eval + auto-safety hooks, 4) flip 0.2% canary for 48h if ablation looks OK. kill conditions per Maya. I'll upload artifacts and a short dashboard link. tagging @Liam Chen @Maya Thompson for sign-off.

spec-bot: note: uploaded samples and diffs -> /artifacts/1739998888/samples_diff.tar.gz (80 cases). ablation jobs enqueued: jobs/1739998888/*

Maya Thompson: thanks. I'll start dashboard + alert plumbing (per-route regen gauge + sample sink). ops will only enable traffic after explicit ablation sign-off and Ravi's human QC.

Liam Chen: I'll schedule the adversarial prompt run and add plots to the ablation report (regen vs p95/throughput).

Aisha Patel: will post updates + final CSV of metrics when ablation finishes.
